items.text: What's new FAB placement — ★ is a corner FAB again, stacked below the / tag cloud (left by default; mirrored for left/right docks; anchored to the side-rail bottom). It no longer sits in the centre dock toolbar.
Status-row highlight — bookmark hover and keyboard selection on status rows use the shared row tokens again; config save-mode pill shows translated labels after tab switches.
Merge regressions — dashboard static assets and config page load (config-persistence.js) restored after main/dev merge conflicts.
Config → Help — Show what's new at the top of the Help tab opens the ★ modal; the overlay uses the same wide shell and layout tokens as on the dashboard.
Save indicator — unsaved-changes feedback on the save row is visible again when edits are pending.
README, MANUAL, Config Help & What's new — hotfix notes for v2026.07.05.1 (EN/NL/DE/FR).
Cache-bust — whats-new-v129 data version; 2026.07-dashboard-release-v98 dashboard release token; FAB and config-help CSS query strings.
